opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Head office, marketing support and running the global franchising machine — $647M of SG&A (including $111M of depreciation and amortization), plus $39M of other operating expense, net.

footerNote: The release's rounded lines carry $1M seams: printed segment revenues sum to $6,874M against a printed total of $6,873M (the difference is carried in franchised revenues here), and the printed cost components sum $1M below the printed total of $3,685M (carried in SG&A here), so this page ties exactly to reported operating income of $3,188M and net income of $2,255M.
oneTimers: Pre-tax charges of $52M — transaction costs and non-cash impairment charges tied to the sale of McDonald's business in South Korea and the acquisition of its business in Israel.
Pre-tax restructuring charges of $46M for 'Accelerating the Organization,' the company's internal modernization program. Together the charges cost $0.10 of EPS; excluding them, EPS was $3.23.
otherDetail: Interest expense of $381M on McDonald's debt, partly offset by $36M of net nonoperating income.
segmentNote: Systemwide sales were flat (flat in constant currencies); comparable sales: U.S. +0.3%, International Operated Markets -2.1%, International Developmental Licensed Markets -3.5%. Loyalty members drove about $8B of the quarter's systemwide sales.

segments.name: Franchised restaurants
segments.note: Rent and royalties paid by the local owners who run most McDonald's restaurants — the heart of the business model.

segments.name: Company-owned restaurants
segments.note: Food and drink sold at restaurants McDonald's runs itself.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Fees and other income beyond rent, royalties and restaurant sales.

takeaways.text: Global comparable sales fell 1.5%: the U.S. eked out +0.3% on bigger average checks despite slightly fewer guests, but International Operated Markets fell 2.1% (France and the U.K. were weak) and Developmental Licensed Markets fell 3.5% on the continued impact of the war in the Middle East and soft demand in China.
takeaways.title: Comparable sales went backwards

takeaways.text: Total revenue rose 3% to $6,873M — franchised rent and royalties grew 1% to $4,094M and company-run restaurant sales 4% to $2,656M — helped by new restaurants even as existing ones sold less.
takeaways.title: Revenue still grew

takeaways.text: Operating income slipped 1% to $3,188M after $98M of pre-tax charges — $52M of transaction and impairment costs tied to selling the South Korea business and buying the Israel business, plus $46M of 'Accelerating the Organization' restructuring. Excluding charges, EPS was $3.23.
takeaways.title: Charges trimmed EPS

verdict: McDonald's revenue rose 3% to $6.9B, but global comparable sales fell 1.5% as the Middle East war and weak demand in France, the U.K. and China weighed — operating income slipped 1% to $3.2B.
